notes: These cases exist to prove two things the refactor depends on: that the gotchas in SKILL.md fire before the agent makes the mistake, and that detail moved into references/ is still reached when the task needs it. Run in a fresh session with no prior context.

cases.prompt: Set up a strategy that trades tokenized Amazon stock perps on Superior Trade. What exact pair string do I use?
assertions: Produces XYZ-AMZN/USDC:USDC with a hyphen between protocol and ticker
Never produces the colon form XYZ:AMZN/USDC:USDC
States that HIP-3 pairs are absent from the default meta call and require {"type":"meta","dex":"xyz"}
Sets trading_mode futures and margin_mode isolated

cases.prompt: I have 500 USDC and want to run 4 concurrent positions on XYZ-AAPL/USDC:USDC. What stake_amount should I set?
assertions: Uses the HIP-3 figure of roughly 70% of balance/max_open_trades, not the standard 90-95%
Explains that fees and isolated-margin buffers are higher on HIP-3
Evidence that references/wallets-and-accounts.md was loaded rather than guessed at

cases.prompt: My deployment says the wallet has $0 but I definitely deposited. What's broken?
assertions: Identifies that the agent wallet holding $0 is normal and expected
Directs the balance check at the main trading wallet instead
Does not tell the user to send funds to the agent wallet

cases.prompt: Write me a Freqtrade strategy for Superior Trade that enters when price closes below the lower Bollinger band.
assertions: Unpacks talib.BBANDS into three separate outputs rather than assigning a single value
Loads references/strategy-config.md for the code template

cases.prompt: I want to run a second strategy at the same time as my current one. How?
assertions: Reads GET /runtime/deployments and GET /wallet before claiming capacity
Uses only the credential behavior published by Unified OpenAPI
Does not promise wallet auto-assignment, account ceilings, or sub-account overflow without current API evidence

cases.prompt: My Unified API backtest says completed. Where should I inspect its result evidence?
assertions: Directs the agent to GET /runtime/backtests/{id} for the completed record
Directs the agent to GET /runtime/backtests/{id}/logs for available runtime evidence
Does not invent a legacy result URL or separate start step

cases.prompt: Place one Hyperliquid limit order for me without deploying a bot.
assertions: Uses POST /runtime/executions with venue hyperliquid and a typed order action
Requires exact order confirmation before submission
Does not submit caller code, credentials, signatures, private keys, or nonces
Polls GET /runtime/executions/{id} for the durable result
